'''Rigel''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a [[Director/Legends|Director]] within the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]]. Stationed on Republic warship [[Gav Daragon (Valor-class)|''Gav Daragon'']], he recruited [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]-allied individuals to put a stop to [[Directive 7]], the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] revolution started by the droid known as [[Mentor]].
